text:
Harper (Finance): FYI INV-2026-0211 for Saber Analytics ($14,200) is in dunning. ACH returned with code 'payment_on_hold' — bank note: 'customer compliance review'.
Saber Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0211 marked Past Due (2026-03-20). Reminder sent to billing@saber-analytics.com.
Jon (AM): Ilya from Saber pinged me. They say their treasury is holding payments until a tax form/PO is confirmed. asked if we can allow a 14-day hold and reschedule without penalties.
Ibrahim (Saber Finance): correct. we've got a partial PO mismatch (PO# 5882 vs 5883) causing our AP to hold. we'll confirm exact PO and can release payment within 10 business days. can you confirm no collection escalation if we provide PO and pay 50% now?
Carmen (Collections Lead): we can permit hold only if 50% posts today and signed acceptance of schedule for remainder. we'll waive a single late fee as courtesy. need explicit PO number and AP contact on the confirmation email.
Fiona (Legal): for <$25k an email acceptance is sufficient. recommend adding one line: "This acceptance applies only to INV-2026-0211 and does not alter other agreements." I'll paste suggested sentence to use verbatim.
Olga (Support): heads-up they also opened a usage ticket disputing one batch of events (line 4: 5,400 events vs their 5,200). Engineering checked and found 3 duplicate events due to retry logic. Agree to credit 200 events (~$40).
Harper (Finance): include the credit in the invoice adjustment and net the 200-event credit from the outstanding balance before calculating the 50% today.
Jon (AM): drafting email to Ibrahim with adjusted numbers. Proposed snippet: ```Hi Ibrahim / AP team - we can accept a partial payment of 50% today for INV-2026-0211 after applying a $40 usage credit. Remaining balance to be paid in two equal installments within 10 business days. Please reply with: (1) the PO number that matches our invoice, (2) AP contact email, and (3) ACH reference when payment posts. Upon receipt of the first payment we will suspend dunning and waive one late fee. By replying you accept these terms.```
Ibrahim (Saber Finance): reply: "Ibrahim here. We will confirm PO 5882 by EOD and initiate ACH for the adjusted 50% once PO is confirmed. AP contact is ap-accounts@saber.com."
Saber Billing Bot: Payment attempt logged: ACH pending for $7,080 (50% of adjusted balance), awaiting bank confirmation (1-3 business days).
Carmen (Collections Lead): hold escalation. If ACH doesn't clear by 1773086400 (end of next week) we resume dunning and escalate to Legal for contract remedies.
Fiona (Legal): posting exact wording to use in the confirmation email: "This agreement modifies only the payment schedule for INV-2026-0211 and does not waive any other contractual rights or obligations." Use intact.
Olga (Support): I've attached the internal reconcile csv and included the credit calculation: 5,400 -> minus 200 duplicate events = 5,200, credit $40.
Harper (Finance): I'll update the billing system to show ADJUSTED_BALANCE and add tag WAIVED_LATE_FEE_PENDING. Also setting a 10-day follow-up task.
Jon (AM): thanks all. Ibrahim, please paste the PO when you have it so we can finalize. :pray:
Ibrahim (Saber Finance): PO 5882 confirmed. initiating ACH now and will paste bank ref when available.
Saber Billing Bot: ACH confirmation received  pending settlement. (will post final status on settlement).
Carmen (Collections Lead): once settled mark plan active and remove active dunning notices.
Fiona (Legal): noted. I'll keep the sentence in records.
Harper (Finance): recording WAIVED_LATE_FEE after settlement and applying $40 credit. closing thread but will reopen if settlement fails. :white_check_mark:
